# Model report — Kforce Data Analyst ML project

*Generated by `Rscript run_all.R` on 2026-11-18. All data is synthetic
(set.seed 42/43). All metrics are measured on the 61-day time-based
hold-out (2025-11-01 to 2025-12-30), never on training data.*

## Data
- Daily aggregate: 730 days (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-30); channel grain: 3650 rows
  (5 channels x 730 days).
- Data-quality validation: kpi_daily missing=0, duplicates=0,
  date gaps=0; pipeline_health missing=0, duplicates=0, gaps=0.
- Pipeline-health log: 25 injected data-quality incidents.

## Problem 1 — KPI / service-performance forecasting
| model | target | MAE | RMSE | MAPE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| seasonal_naive | sla_attainment_pct | 1.10 | 1.31 | 1.15 |
| holt_winters | sla_attainment_pct | 0.79 | 0.98 | 0.83 |
| linear | sla_attainment_pct | 0.80 | 0.98 | 0.83 |
| random_forest | sla_attainment_pct | 0.76 | 0.93 | 0.80 |
| gradient_boosting | sla_attainment_pct | 0.80 | 0.97 | 0.84 |
| seasonal_naive | tickets_received | 50.05 | 65.19 | 3.23 |
| holt_winters | tickets_received | 62.74 | 77.87 | 6.89 |
| linear | tickets_received | 33.11 | 40.36 | 3.05 |
| random_forest | tickets_received | 104.69 | 132.30 | 6.15 |
| gradient_boosting | tickets_received | 90.71 | 117.21 | 5.32 |

Best SLA forecaster: **random_forest** (MAPE 0.80%). Best volume forecaster:
**linear** (MAPE 3.05%). Holt-Winters 14-day-ahead MAPE on the first
14 hold-out days: 0.83%.

## Problem 2 — Data-quality anomaly detection
Z-score rule on 8 pipeline-health features: flag a day when any
feature is more than 4 SD out, or the composite health score is
more than 4 SD above its mean.
Precision 0.714, recall 1.000, F1 0.833 — 35 days flagged, 25 true
incidents (25 caught, 0 missed, 10 false alarms).

## Problem 3 — What drives SLA attainment
Top 3 drivers (permutation importance, gradient boosting):
1. backlog_ratio (0.7609)
2. staffing_ratio (0.0933)
3. system_uptime_pct (0.0729)

Channel benchmark (mean SLA): Helpdesk 96.9%, Billing Support 95.9%, Publishing Ops 95.0%, Field Service 94.4%, Onboarding 93.1%.

## Honest limits
- Synthetic data: magnitudes and rankings are illustrative, not
  evidence about any real client.
- R is the executable reference implementation. The STATA (.do),
  SPSS (.sps) and SAS (.sas) scripts replicate the same data, splits
  and metrics; they were authored and syntax-reviewed but not executed
  on this machine (commercial software not installed) — run them in
  the licensed application to reproduce the comparison table.
- Same-day operational features are used only for driver analysis,
  never for forecasting (that would leak).
